responsibility: Implements GCC’s dbx/stabs debug-information emitter, the backend that turns declarations, types, scopes, and selected runtime tables into .stabs/.stabn/.stabd style assembler records. It owns numbering and state for stabs type descriptions, emission of symbol records for functions, variables, typedefs, parameters, and lexical blocks, handling of source-file and scope markers, formatting and continuation of long stab strings, and target-conditioned variants shared with XCOFF-enabled builds; it also provides the default stabs-based constructor/destructor set emitters used on targets that encode those tables via stab records.
same_name_distinction: Pairs with dbxout.h as the implementation side of the dbx/stabs backend: it contains the stateful logic that emits stabs records and, when XCOFF debugging is enabled, includes and uses xcoffout.h customizations. Unlike dbxout.h, which only declares the API and constants, this file performs the actual debug-info generation.
